_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

classification.quality_note: Although the overwhelming majority of the cash generated by KMP’s assets is fee based and is not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and natural gas liquids. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.01x; +2% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.50; conservative 2yr +40%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY12-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.5%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 2.1-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +105.4%/yr (FY12-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +105.4%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY12-FY13: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2014-01-31) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.01x (-5.9% downside to Bear $36 / +779.2% upside to Bull $299) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 1.00: gap +1.50 [UNDERVALUED] | +2% above the EPP floor $33 (29x FY14E $1.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: +40.3% total (+20.1%/yr) | At 29.6x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $45 sits at or below the BASE case; segment EBDA n/r and Natural Gas Pipelines n/r in Q4 2013, forward revenues +25.8% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
